title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.22355v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Public transit route planning traditionally depends on structured map infrastructure and complex routing engines, and no existing dataset supports training models to bypass this dependency. We present TransitLM, a large-scale dataset of nearly 13 million transit route planning records from four Chinese cities covering 120,845 stations and 13,666 lines, released as a continual pre-training corpus and benchmark data for three evaluation tasks with complementary metrics. Experiments show that an LLM trained on TransitLM produces structurally valid routes at high accuracy and implicitly grounds arbitrary GPS coordinates to appropriate stations without any explicit mapping. These results demonstrate that transit route planning can be learned entirely from data, enabling end-to-end, map-free route generation directly from origin-destination information. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/GD-ML/

translated_title: TransitLM：面向无地图公交路线生成的大规模数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 公共交通路线规划传统上依赖于结构化地图基础设施和复杂的路由引擎，目前尚无数据集支持训练模型来摆脱这一依赖。我们提出了TransitLM，这是一个包含来自四个中国城市的近1300万条公交路线规划记录的大规模数据集，覆盖120,845个车站和13,666条线路，以持续预训练语料库的形式发布，并附带三个评估任务的基准数据及互补的评估指标。实验表明，在TransitLM上训练的大语言模型能够以高准确率生成结构有效的路线，并能在没有任何显式映射的情况下，隐式地将任意GPS坐标对齐到合适的车站。这些结果表明，公共交通路线规划可以完全从数据中学习，从而实现直接根据起终点信息进行端到端、无地图的路线生成。数据集和基准已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/GD-ML/ 公开。
tldr: 该论文发布了包含四个中国城市近1300万条路线规划记录的大规模数据集TransitLM，证明大语言模型可完全从数据中学习公交路线规划，无需地图即可实现从起终点信息到路线的端到端生成。
en_tdlr: TransitLM is a large-scale dataset of nearly 13 million transit route records from four Chinese cities, demonstrating that LLMs can learn transit route planning entirely from data, enabling end-to-end, map-free route generation directly from origin-destination information.
